LanguageData.RMush_AteButton.stages.0.label: subtle button mushroom flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteButton.stages.0.description: There's something comforting about that mild aroma. Its gentle flavor makes me want another bite.
LanguageData.RMush_AteShiitake.stages.0.label: rich shiitake umami
LanguageData.RMush_AteShiitake.stages.0.description: Every chew releases more savory flavor. It's like someone tucked a bowl of rich broth inside a little mushroom.
LanguageData.RMush_AteOyster.stages.0.label: subtle oyster mushroom umami
LanguageData.RMush_AteOyster.stages.0.description: The tender flesh pulls apart in delicate strands. That quiet savory flavor keeps calling me back for another bite.
LanguageData.RMush_AteKingOyster.stages.0.label: springy king oyster mushrooms
LanguageData.RMush_AteKingOyster.stages.0.description: That springy stem makes a substantial bite. One piece of mushroom, and I feel like I'm tucking into a little steak.
LanguageData.RMush_AteEnoki.stages.0.label: crisp enoki
LanguageData.RMush_AteEnoki.stages.0.description: Crunch, crunch. Those slender stems are keeping a cheerful little rhythm in my mouth.
LanguageData.RMush_AteWoodEar.stages.0.label: chewy wood ear mushrooms
LanguageData.RMush_AteWoodEar.stages.0.description: Those chewy little pieces put up a springy resistance. I'll remember this one for the fun of chewing it.
LanguageData.RMush_AteBeech.stages.0.label: crunchy beech mushrooms
LanguageData.RMush_AteBeech.stages.0.description: A crisp little bite, then a gentle nutty flavor follows. These little ones have plenty going for them.
LanguageData.RMush_AteMaitake.stages.0.label: rich maitake flavor
LanguageData.RMush_AteMaitake.stages.0.description: Each thin frond unfolds another layer of rich flavor. It feels like a little forest in a single bite.
LanguageData.RMush_AteLionsMane.stages.0.label: tender lion's mane
LanguageData.RMush_AteLionsMane.stages.0.description: Tender strands unravel like a skein of thread, with a little sweetness too. It tastes as comforting as it looks.
LanguageData.RMush_AteMatsutake.stages.0.label: pine-scented matsutake
LanguageData.RMush_AteMatsutake.stages.0.description: One bite brings a pine forest to mind. I want to linger over that aroma before taking the next.
